title: DID Management — Account Expiry Notice — payload
description: A DID hosting service tells an account holder that its account is about to be disabled for inactivity, has been, or is about to be purged. Fire-and-forget: there is no success response. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

stage.description: Which notice this is. `disablePending`: the account will be disabled at `account.disableAt` unless renewed. `disabled`: its DIDs no longer resolve, and it will be purged at `account.purgeAt` unless renewed. `purgePending`: the last notice before `account.purgeAt`.
